meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 安装后，NanoClaw 获得 OpenCode 代理提供方，可通过它接入 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型服务，并且可以按代理组切换使用。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 使用 OpenCode 作为代理提供方，或让某个代理组改用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型时触发。

say.text: 把 OpenCode 设置成代理提供方，接上 DeepSeek。
say.note: 会复制 OpenCode 文件并重建容器镜像。

say.text: 将代理组 my-group 切换到 opencode。
帮我配置 OpenRouter 作为 OpenCode 上游。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw gets OpenCode as an agent provider, which can connect to OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc., and can be switched per agent group.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want NanoClaw to use OpenCode as the agent provider, or switch an agent group to OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc.

say_en.text: Set up OpenCode as the provider and connect DeepSeek.
say_en.note: Copies OpenCode files and rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Switch agent group my-group to opencode.
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update and restarts.

say_en.text: Configure OpenRouter as the upstream for OpenCode.
